title: Reward-Guided RRT* for Budgeted Task and Motion Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35289v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic missions involving spatially distributed tasks often require jointly selecting rewarding locations and planning feasible motions under limited travel budgets. This paper proposes Reward-Guided RRT*, a new sampling-based framework that constructs a budget-feasible mission through a sequence of locally joint task-selection-and-motion-planning stages, evaluated directly in the continuous state space, without requiring a precomputed task-transition graph. The method incrementally builds a mission using reward-guided RRT* searches, while a return-feasibility procedure ensures that each selected task can be visited without violating the mission budget. Experiments with increasing obstacle complexity and number of tasks show solutions comparable to VNS-PRM* while requiring substantially fewer sampled states. translated_title: 面向预算约束任务与运动规划的奖励引导RRT*
translated_abstract: 涉及空间分布任务的机器人任务往往需要在有限的行进预算下，联合选择具有收益的地点并规划可行的运动。本文提出了奖励引导RRT*（Reward-Guided RRT*），这是一种新的基于采样的框架，通过一系列局部联合的任务选择与运动规划阶段来构建预算可行的任务方案，直接在连续状态空间中进行评估，无需预先计算任务转移图。该方法利用奖励引导的RRT*搜索逐步构建任务方案，同时通过回报可行性程序确保每个被选中的任务都能在不违反任务预算的情况下被访问。在障碍物复杂度和任务数量不断增加的实验中，该方法获得了与VNS-PRM*相当的解决方案，同时所需的采样状态数大幅减少。我们还将该框架扩展到Dubins转向模型，并在CoppeliaSim中利用缩比车式机器人平台进行了评估，验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 提出奖励引导RRT*框架，在有限行进预算下直接于连续状态空间中联合执行任务选择与运动规划，无需预计算任务转移图即可构建预算可行的机器人任务方案，且比VNS-PRM*所需采样状态大幅减少。
en_tdlr: Proposes Reward-Guided RRT*, a sampling-based framework that jointly performs task selection and motion planning directly in continuous state space under limited travel budgets, constructing budget-feasible missions without precomputed task-transition graphs while requiring substantially fewer sampled states than VNS-PRM*.
